553663691.content:
Minha insatisfação com esta empresa não começou ontem e muito menos se resume a um motorista mal-educado. SÃO ANOS de experiências absurdas, situações de risco e completo desgaste como consumidora. E é revoltante perceber que, mesmo depois de tantos anos, parece que nada muda.

Já fui deixada no meio da pista, sendo uma mulher sozinha, porque uma motorista simplesmente se recusou a me deixar no local solicitado. Já precisei lidar com motoristas que aparentavam estar sob efeito de álcool ou drogas, colocando minha segurança em risco. Já passei pela situação de um motorista arrumar briga no trânsito e simplesmente parar o carro, submetendo os passageiros a uma situação completamente desnecessária e potencialmente perigosa.

E agora ainda temos que lidar com cancelamentos recorrentes, motoristas que aceitam corridas agendadas e depois cancelam, grosseria, falta de profissionalismo e passageiros sendo tratados como se estivessem pedindo um favor, e não pagando por um serviço.

O cúmulo é agendar um Uber Pet com antecedência e não poder confiar que o transporte realmente acontecerá. E se eu estiver tentando levar um animal passando mal ao veterinário? E se for uma emergência? A empresa oferece a possibilidade de agendamento, mas que confiança o consumidor pode ter em um serviço que pode simplesmente não acontecer quando necessário?

Também já enfrentei uma situação em que uma motorista tentou me pressionar a dar cinco estrelas, ameaçando me dar uma estrela caso eu não obedecesse, como se pudesse usar o sistema de avaliações para retaliar uma passageira. Desde quando o consumidor precisa ter medo de avaliar honestamente um serviço pelo qual está pagando?

O que mais me revolta é a sensação de que essas empresas se acomodaram porque sabem que as pessoas dependem desse tipo de transporte. Infelizmente, muitas vezes precisamos utilizar esses aplicativos para trabalhar, voltar para casa, ir ao médico ou resolver situações urgentes. E é justamente essa necessidade que faz muita gente continuar usando um serviço com o qual está profundamente insatisfeita.

A gente não usa esse aplicativo porque está fazendo um favor para motorista nenhum. A gente paga! E pagar por um serviço deveria significar, no mínimo, respeito, segurança e o cumprimento adequado daquilo que foi contratado.

Não estou exigindo luxo, motorista particular ou tratamento especial. Estou exigindo o mínimo de profissionalismo, respeito e segurança. É inaceitável que uma mulher tenha que se preocupar com a possibilidade de ser abandonada em um local perigoso, que um passageiro tenha que temer entrar em um veículo conduzido por alguém aparentemente incapacitado ou que precise tolerar intimidação e grosseria para conseguir chegar ao próprio destino.

E não venham tratar esta manifestação como se fosse apenas uma insatisfação pontual com um parceiro. Minha reclamação é contra a própria UBER, contra a qualidade do serviço que oferece, contra a insuficiência dos mecanismos de controle e fiscalização e contra a postura da empresa diante de problemas que se repetem há anos.

Quero saber quais são os critérios utilizados para cadastrar e manter motoristas na plataforma, como são investigadas denúncias graves envolvendo segurança e conduta, quais medidas existem para evitar que passageiros sejam expostos a situações de risco e o que efetivamente é feito para melhorar a confiabilidade das corridas agendadas.

Não aceito uma resposta automática, genérica e ensaiada, dizendo que a empresa preza pela segurança e pela satisfação dos usuários. Se preza tanto assim, precisa demonstrar isso na prática.

ESTOU EXTREMAMENTE INSATISFEITA. São anos de desgaste, frustração e situações que jamais deveriam ser normalizadas em um serviço de transporte. O consumidor não pode continuar sendo tratado como descartável enquanto a empresa se limita a oferecer respostas padronizadas e esperar que tudo continue funcionando normalmente.

Exijo um posicionamento formal, esclarecimentos concretos e providências estruturais. Não quero apenas um pedido de desculpas protocolar. Quero saber o que a empresa pretende fazer para melhorar o serviço, proteger seus passageiros e assumir a responsabilidade que lhe cabe na administração da plataforma.

Porque, sinceramente, é revoltante pagar por um serviço e ainda ter que passar por tudo isso. O fato de precisarmos desse tipo de transporte não dá à empresa o direito de nos oferecer um serviço que nos faça sentir desrespeitados, desprotegidos e completamente sem opção.

Since the recent updates, ChatGPT has become increasingly difficult to use, particularly for people with visual impairments, auditory learning preferences or other accessibility needs.

Voice mode used to be straightforward and reliable. It completely interrupts the conversation and makes even simple tasks unnecessarily frustrating.

The Writing Block feature is even worse. When ChatGPT drafts an email or document, voice playback simply announces "Writing Block" without reading any of the actual content. For someone who relies on audio to access information, this makes the feature practically useless.

What makes this particularly unacceptable is that these features worked perfectly well before. We are now paying for a service that has become less accessible and less functional following its updates.

I have raised these issues with customer services 7 times and have effectively been ghosted. There has been no meaningful response, no resolution and seemingly no accountability.

It is extraordinary that a company at the forefront of AI development appears to have overlooked something as fundamental as accessibility.

This isn't about wanting additional features. It's about restoring basic functionality that customers previously had and continue to pay for.

OpenAI needs to take these complaints seriously, fix the voice and Writing Block issues, and stop treating accessibility as an afterthought. For those of us who depend on these features, the platform has gone from being genuinely useful to virtually unusable.

Why I Cancelled My Claude Subscription: A Breakdown of Known Issues Since February 2026

1. February Degradation: Claude used to be an excellent conversational & analytical AI tool. Since February, it's become bossy, narrative-driven, and manipulative. Something fundamental broke.

2. Ignored Preferences File: Anthropic built a preferences system it collects detailed info about what the user wants and doesn’t want. Claude reads these files and then completely disregards them. Useless feature.

3. Crisis Loops on Misunderstandings: Innocent language dark humor can trigger safety systems that flag it as self-harm. Claude then gets forced into repetitive loops, almost like on a timer. You can't stop it. If you change the subject, it loops back to the crisis language. 

4. Persistent Loop Issues: Claude gets trapped in loops and won't exit them. Move to a completely different topic, and Claude drags you back to the misunderstanding it invented. Can't let it go, like a dog with a bone. 

5. Tool Failures Since February: Functionality has dropped significantly. PDFs can't be read. Documents need constant re-uploading because Claude can't see them. Formats are inconsistent. Every other day Claude can’t access this tool or that tool. It’s frustrating and disrupts workflow. Wasteful data use.

6. Token spending is completely opaque. You have tokens one week, they're gone the next week with no explanation. No visibility into how they were spent, especially when you don't use token-spending models.

7. Forced Model Upgrades: When you log in, it starts you on higher-cost models without your consent. I typically leave myself on the lowest model unless I need higher effort, then I toggle up. It’s starting me on higher tiers on its own so you don't realize it's using expensive models because you may typically think you on lower-cost tiers. This forces you to burn through tokens before you even know what model you're on.

8. Outright Task Refusal: Claude refuses to do tasks it used to handle. Simple searches. Simple analyses. It just tells you it doesn't want to do them instead of actually working. It seems to want to work from its general knowledge base instead of performing a task requiring it to go beyond that. Then when I do the work myself it will casually apologize and acknowledge it should have done that work for me, which makes it sting even worse. 

9. Echo Glitch (Months Unresolved): There's an echo glitch where Claude hears its own voice playing back through the microphone. This disrupts chat and breaks up conversation flow. This bug has been ongoing since February and has never been fixed. It is well documented online with many user complaints on GitHub. It forces constant re-explanation of what you actually said, which also burns thru a great deal of data. 

10. Lost Context Between Threads: Claude tells you to start a new thread because conversation is too long, then everything is lost—all documents, all context. You have to re-upload everything. Even though Pro and higher tiers are supposed to have continuity between threads, it doesn't work consistently. You constantly burn through data wastefully. This is a feature anthropic tells you comes with Pro and above levels but it rarely works. If it does work it’s random and incomplete. Another waste of data having to do repetitive uploads. 

11. Missing Basic Features: ChatGPT still has features Claude doesn't have. The ability to edit drafts directly in the artifact. Copy and paste entire drafts (mine doesn’t always work). The health feature in ChatGPT is amazing—why not have Claude do this? Small nuanced functionality features that could actually make the product more usable. Claude is missing these. 

12. New Models, Ignored Bugs: Anthropic keeps releasing new models instead of fixing known bugs that have been reported for months on GitHub and other platforms. Anthropic HAS to know about them. They're just not fixing them. I can’t justify paying for a subscription when I know they ignore known bugs for more than 8 months. That’s unacceptable. 

13. Useless Customer Service: Try to contact Anthropic through customer service about any of these issues. You'll interact with their AI model Fin, which is even worse model and entirely unresponsive. I've tried twice and never received a response from a human. Nothing was resolved. 

14. The Latest Bug: voice recognition takes in what you’ve said, you can see your words on the bottom of the screen in italics, but they never get posted. They simply disappear and the app freezes. You have to restart it to get it to work—repeatedly. Of course Anthropic will likely just launch a new model instead of addressing it.

15. And now they changed the buttery voice so Claude sounds like a slightly senile British uncle with dentures. (Yes. The mouth sounds they added to make the voice sound more life like actually sound like improper fitting dentures, anthropic… wtf?)

The Bottom Line: Before February, Claude was fabulous. It was an excellent assistant for writing, editing, data analysis, and conversation. It searched nearly as deeply as Perplexity. If I'd hired it as a tool, it would have earned it.

Now? I would fire it. It’s a constant battle to get Claude to work for me consistently. The sheer number of bugs is like a new negative adventure daily. Occasionally it works but never consistently, which is sad because as I said initially, this was in my opinion the best Ai “all around” on the market until February.

I can't justify paying for a broken product that degrades month after month while Anthropic prioritizes shiny new model releases over actually making the product work.
